messages:
Alex H: Starting SFO2 region bring-up verification. Control plane + node pools provisioned. Need quick validation on smoke tests, SLO gates, and a short readiness checklist before handoff to oncall. Please ping :thumbsup: when done.

Maria G: Copy. Minimal checklist I want validated: kube control-plane health, kube-proxy, GPU drivers, CNI routes, storage provisioning, LB/TLS, canary routing + rollback, billing tags.

Maria G: Quick commands I ran locally (for context):
```
kubectl --context sfo2 get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node gpu-01-sfo2
nvidia-smi -L
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector status.phase!=Running
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz
```
Node gpu-03 had driver mismatch, I cordoned + rebooted and driver auto-updated.

Provision Bot: Provision job complete: node-pool-gpu-8 created (8 nodes) — 2025-11-08T09:00:12Z. AMI: rinf-gpu-2.3.1, CUDA:12.1, NCCL:2.16. Logs: /infra/provision/1753004821/logs

Devon Ops: Networking checks I ran from bastion:
- VPC peering to core OK
- NAT gateways in AZ-a,b configured
- Security groups allow 443,10250,30000-32767
- iperf between gpu nodes ~9.4Gbps, <2% packet loss
Note: if control-plane endpoints resolve across AZs ensure route propagation to avoid kubelet heartbeat flaps.

Katie SRE: Proposed SLO gates before handoff:
- p99 inference latency (short runs) < 150ms at 10rps canary
- 5m error rate < 0.5%
- GPU mem < 85% at peak during soak
- No OOMKills in 30m soak
- Ephemeral disk write IOPS > 5k for batch path
Fallback: route -> eu-west4 on gate fail.

Maria G: Canary steps (run from CI or ops laptop):
1) Apply model route: ModelRoute weight=5% -> sfo2
2) Load: `hey -z 5m -q 10 -c 20 http://router.sfo2.internal/v1/generate`
3) Monitor p99, error_rate, gpu_mem, oom_kills
4) If p99>150ms OR error_rate>0.5% -> scale weight to 0% and rollback

Devon Ops: Added smoke scripts to infra bastion: /scripts/sfo2/smoke_health.sh (kube, drivers, cni), /scripts/sfo2/smoke_net.sh (curl, iperf, traceroute). Recommend CI run with `--retry 3` pre-handoff.

Maria G: Cost estimate: 8 x A100-like ~ $32/hr GPU + ~$10/hr network/storage. Tag nodes `env:sfo2`,`cost-center:infra-gpu` or finance won't attribute.

Devon Ops: NAT quota check: current quota allows 2x burst. Added terraform autoscaler: nat-gateway-burst=2, nat-threshold=0.8 to avoid stalls.

Provision Bot: Canary applied: model-route/canary-sfo2 weight=5% — 2025-11-08T09:18:02Z

Katie SRE: Running canary now, will post snapshot in ~6m.

Katie SRE: Canary snapshot:
- p50 33ms, p95 72ms, p99 134ms ✅
- error rate 0.15% ✅
- GPU mem avg 60% peak 78% ✅
- OOMKills 0 ✅
- Disk IOPS sustained 6.1k ✅
Looks good. Recommend handoff to oncall and remove automatic fallback.

Alex H: Final pre-handoff items: ensure billing tags on pools, update SLO dashboards with region filter, post runbook link to #oncall-sre and add first-24h watch. I'll hand off at 2025-11-08T10:00 UTC if no objections.

Maria G: Request 24h soak and 7-day cost review. Also reserve headroom for burst training jobs.

Devon Ops: Runbook updated with 24h soak, terraform cost tags, and a recovery snippet: `kubectl cordon <node>; kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets; revert weight`.

Katie SRE: Handoff acked. Dashboards linked. :thumbsup:

Alex H: Handover done. Oncall confirmed receipt. Closing thread. Thanks all for quick turnaround.
